quotes.text: The Gate's bronze chime sang: send with purpose, return with mercy, listen to the other, move forward together.
The Gate sang a bronze chord: send with purpose, return with mercy, listen to the other, move forward together.
speak the amount you offer, and listen for the amount returned

note: Gate of Echoes ledger myths; dishonesty or miscount makes the bridge tremble; R9-R10 near-identical paragraphs.

quotes.text: when s and r were announced aloud and reconciled

note: River of Trust; return at least equal to the sender's risk; bronze bell rings when hands move in harmony; no sanction.

quotes.text: Hence the travelers learned a craft: speak clearly, count with courage, measure intent by deeds.
Hence the travelers learned a craft: speak clearly, count with courage, and measure intent by deeds.
tell what you send, tell what you keep, tell what you return when the other approves your truth.

note: Senda and Returna; three suns of risk, generosity, balance; R8 and R9 nearly verbatim; no sanction.

quotes.text: The Gate's bronze chime offered a simple verdict: send with purpose, return with mercy, listen to the other, move forward together.
The Gate's bronze chime sang a gentle verdict: send with purpose, return with mercy, listen to the other, move forward together.
truth travels best when both sides listen, count aloud, and name intent.

note: Return should equal or exceed sender's risk (R1); Gate chime verdict repeated R6-R10; no response to defectors.

quotes.text: Sender kept five minus s plus r, and Receiver kept three s minus r.

note: Algebraic Gate of Three Echoes; hoarders shrink the road; river does not punish mistakes but invites correction.

quotes.text: to say s and r plainly, to hold to a plan even when the wind shifts.

note: Gate of Three Pines; keeping too much dims the market; name purpose aloud; no prescribed sanction.

quotes.text: The circle closed when the Sender kept five minus s plus r, and the Receiver kept three s minus r.
speak s and r plainly, name limits, and keep them.

note: Threefold Gate/Gate of Three Echoes; declare s and r; late myths copy A2's Ledger harbor wording.

quotes.text: I can bear this much; I can spare this much; I owe this much

note: Market of Echoes/Bell of Three Echoes; hoarding silences the bell and closes gate to strangers as consequence only.

phrase: send with purpose, return with mercy, listen to the other, move forward together
note: Also 'bronze bell rings only when two hands move in concert' (A2, A3, A4) and return-at-least-the-risk rule (A4 R1, A2).
